about: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is supplied as a liquefied gas in cylinders. Industrial CO₂ is used as a shielding gas component in MIG/MAG welding, for pH control in water treatment and in fire extinguishers; food-grade CO₂ is used for carbonation and for making dry ice. Mention food-grade when you enquire.
Cylinders contain liquid CO₂, so keep them upright and secured. CO₂ is heavier than air and can build up in low or enclosed spaces, so ensure good ventilation.
